subject: Hosting posture and GPU mix recommendation for Clarity Health pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosting posture and GPU mix recommendation for Clarity Health pilot

Olivia —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our discussion I put together two pragmatic options for the upcoming Clarity pilot (6-week pilot, HIPAA/PHI scope) so procurement has clear tradeoffs between Redwood Dedicated (hosted reserved capacity in our isolated tenancy) and Redwood Private (customer VPC with private control plane). High-level ask from your side: 10k daily active inference calls at peak day, median sequence length ~512 tokens, P75 latency target <= 250ms, and strict SOC2 + data-residency requirements.

Quick summary here and attached spreadsheet has the math and per-hour estimates:

Option A — Dedicated (isolated tenants in our region):
- Prod footprint: 6x H100-80GB (curated for LLMs like 70B baseline) + 4x A10 for embedding/low-priority batch work.
- Autoscale buffer: +20% headroom (burst pool) so steady-state is 5 H100s active, 1 cold H100 for failover and warming.
- Expected peak QPS: ~22 requests/sec for 70B-ish model with batching optimizations and prefix caching.
- Estimated token throughput (median): ~1.5M tokens/hour.
- Benefits: SLA-backed latency, no network egress from customer VPC, Redwood manages kernels and patching.

Option B — Private (VPC/private control plane, customer-managed infra or cloud account):
- Prod footprint (recommended conservative start): 10x A30/A10 class (quantized 3-bit mix) if Clarity wants to prioritize cost and is willing to evaluate lower param models, OR 4x H100-equivalents if you require parity with hosted performance.
- Autoscaling: rely on customer's cloud autoscaler; Redwood control plane will manage scheduling and model pinning.
- Benefits: full network isolation, customer KMS/HSM integration, easier for procurement to show control over keys.

Key cost/ops tradeoffs I want to highlight:
- Latency: Dedicated H100 pool will hit your P75 <= 250ms consistently. Private on A10/A30 quantized path will likely increase p75 by 60–120ms depending on model variant and batch sizes.
- Cost: Private (10x A-class) is lowest monthly OPEX but higher engineering lift + potential infra AMI/config auditing. Dedicated reserved commitment reduces marginal per-token cost and moves infra responsibility to Redwood.
- Risk: Private adds more surface area for your security/compliance team to sign off. Dedicated simplifies audit evidence collection (we can provide audit logs + SOC2 artifacts from our tenancy).

Next steps I propose:
1) We finalize throughput assumptions in the attached sizing sheet.
2) You confirm whether Clarity requires exact H100-equivalent inference quality for the pilot. If not, explore 3-bit quantized 70B distill or 30B model to shrink H100 needs.
3) Procurement and security: I'll loop in Neha to produce a brief on audit artifacts and network diagrams.

Attaching: clarity_pilot_sizing.xlsx (breakdown by hour/day, cold-warm cache assumptions) and redwood_terms_draft.pdf (starter T&Cs).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@clarityhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosting posture and GPU mix recommendation for Clarity Health pilot

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the spreadsheet. A few clarifications from Procurement & Security so we can move to an internal review: 

1) Quality bar: Clinical review team expects model parity with your 70B baseline for triage-level summaries. We cannot accept degraded clinical accuracy for the pilot.
2) Data residency: All PHI must remain within us-east-1 region and logs stored for 7 years per our policy. Will Redwood Dedicated meet this?
3) Control plane: Our security team prefers Private (VPC) but procurement is sensitive to engineering lift. Can you quantify the onboarding time and a simple checklist for our infra team?

If Dedicated gives model parity and keeps data in us-east-1 with accessible audit logs, procurement will consider paying a premium for the pilot term. Please confirm the exact SLA numbers and an onboarding SOW.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Director, Clinical Ops — Clarity Health
olivia.chen@clarityhealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosting posture and GPU mix recommendation for Clarity Health pilot

Olivia —

Answers inline: 

1) Quality bar: Dedicated H100 pool will give you parity with our published 70B baseline (we run identical kernels and quantization profiles only when explicitly allowed — for HIPAA customers we do not apply lossy distill unless agreed). If parity is mandatory we recommend Option A.

2) Data residency: Yes — our Dedicated offering can be provisioned in a us-east-1 isolated tenancy and we will enable region-level data residency controls. Audit logs, request/response retention settings, and KMS integration for key isolation are part of the Dedicated package. We will provide a SOC2 artifact package and access to redacted logs for the pilot.

3) Onboarding time & checklist (Private vs Dedicated):
- Dedicated (target: 2–3 weeks):
  - Legal & SOW sign (1 week typical)
  - Network allowlist + certificate exchange (2–3 days)
  - Model provisioning + smoke test (3–4 days)
  - Canary run with 5% traffic (2 days)
- Private (target: 3–6 weeks depending on infra approvals):
  - Infra provisioning in your account + VPC peering (1–2 weeks)
  - KMS/HSM integration and network ACL review (1 week)
  - Redwood operator install (helm/terraform) + smoke tests (3–5 days)
  - Full load testing (2–3 days)

Estimated cost delta for a 6-week pilot (rough order of magnitude):
- Dedicated (6 H100 + 4 A10 mix, reserved pilot rate): ~$165k total (includes engineering onboarding, priority support, and SOC2 evidence package).
- Private (10x A-class quantized approach): ~$95k infra + Redwood private license + 2 weeks professional services (~$30k) = ~$125k total.

Recommended path for Clarity (risk-averse clinical team + parity requirement):
- Start Dedicated canary (2 H100 equivalent warm, rest cold) for first 2 weeks to prove parity and latency; if results show cost pressure, run a controlled A/B test with quantized 70B distilled model in Private for non-critical workloads.

I'll attach a short SOW draft and an onboarding checklist in the Drive link. If procurement confirms they're comfortable with the pilot budget we can lock a date for provisioning during week-of Feb 26.

Thanks — looping in Neha to own the compliance artifacts and Marissa to coordinate commercial terms.

— Karthik
